claims.text: The local unnumbered-promo catalog models Premium File 3 with a November 13, 1998 release date.
The local Premium File 3 group models eight contiguous source rows: 211 through 218.
The source group is an unnumbered promotional Premium File 3 object, not a normal expansion with printed set numbers.
The adjacent source row 210 is modeled separately as Neo Era Premium File 3 / Celebi, so this eight-row dossier does not silently absorb it.
Premium File 3 matters because it arranges Johto as a mythic map: the legendary beasts, Lugia and Ho-Oh, and the new Metal/Darkness texture all appear inside one file route.
Collector attention naturally gathers around Ho-Oh, Lugia, Entei, Raikou, Suicune, Skarmory, and Sneasel, while Sudowoodo gives the object a memorable game-world interruption.
A Premium File 3 match should preserve the file route, the source-index range 211-218, and the exact card name together; name alone is not enough for unnumbered promo identity.

special_identification_instructions.trigger: A listing, want, scan, or agent result says Premium File 3, Neo-era Premium File 3, legendary beast file, Lugia file, Ho-Oh file, or one of the eight Premium File 3 card names.
special_identification_instructions.summary: Confirm the November 13, 1998 Premium File 3 route and source-index boundary before treating a card as one of these eight unnumbered promo rows.
steps: Confirm the claimed card is one of source rows 211-218: Entei, Suicune, Raikou, Lugia, Sudowoodo, Skarmory, Sneasel, or Ho-Oh.
Preserve the Premium File 3 route separately from the card name; the unnumbered promo identity is not carried by name alone.
Do not silently absorb adjacent source row 210 / Neo Era Premium File 3 / Celebi into this eight-row group.
Do not merge these rows with Neo Revelation, Neo Genesis, later legendary-beast, Lugia, Ho-Oh, Skarmory, Sneasel, or Sudowoodo printings without route evidence.
For transactional use, ask for full front/back photos, any file/page/insert evidence, and close images of corners, stock, and surface.
not_claiming: official product-boundary proof beyond cited catalogs

narrative.why_it_matters: Premium File 3 feels like the file where Johto stops being merely new and becomes legendary. The beasts roam through it, Lugia and Ho-Oh pull the sky and sea into view, and Metal/Darkness cards make the world feel sharper. The agent lesson is simple and important: these names are famous, but fame is not identity. The file route is what turns them into this object.

The current local Premium File 3 row does not provide an illustrator credit for Entei.
